description: Item icons, rarity frames and the popup panel of the dungeon result sample (Content/Samples/DungeonUi). Until the images arrive, reward slots draw the fallback shapes of the item table, and common and uncommon slots keep their drawn outline.
style: Bright fantasy creature-collecting game UI that fits Docs/Images/dungeon_result.jpg: clean readable silhouettes, a dark outline, soft two-tone shading, light from the top left, saturated colors that stand out on a dark navy interface. No text, logos or watermarks.

items.subject: Golem core: a glowing amber crystal heart set in a cracked stone shell
Ancient machine parts: two bronze gears and a riveted metal plate with faint blue runes
Pure quartz: a cluster of clear pale blue crystals
Capture sphere: a palm-sized crystal orb held in a silver cage with a glowing teal band
Gold coins: a small stack and a pile of shiny gold coins
Reward slot frame for rare items: blue metal border with small studs in the corners and a transparent middle
Reward slot frame for epic items: violet metal border with engraved corners and a transparent middle
Reward slot frame for legendary items: ornate gold border with a small gem in each corner and a transparent middle
Background of the result popup card: dark navy panel with a soft inner gradient and a thin light blue rim
